What it was: a non-normative notebook testing where Σ-GLYPH resource
invariants transfer to other systems, and where the analogy breaks. Its
experiments, reviews, dialogue records and attributed-prediction ledger remain
in the tree unchanged, as records of what was measured and how it was scored at
the time. Reading them again, or restoring them, is not re-adoption.

Anything normative about Σ-GLYPH lives in s0fractal/sigma-glyph.

Re-running the oracle-dependent experiments needs the Σ-GLYPH reference
implementation at its pinned digest (413d1f9805cdbdf4…, sigma-glyph commit
2aa85fc). Against any later sigma-glyph the harness reports SKIPPED, by design.
